title.narrative: Project funding - support work in west africa

description.narrative: In 2025, Ireland’s funding to ISS will support the organisation’s work to advance peace and prosperity in Africa, in line with its 2021-2025 Strategy. A core contribution of €160,000 will support ISS’ core functions, namely staffing and administrative costs. An earmarked contribution of €180,000 will support ISS’ work 1) in West Africa, 2) on climate governance and 3) on transitional justice and accountability, in line with Ireland’s priorities, and policy and programmatic engagement in Africa. In particular, ISS will focus on supporting the prevention and countering of violent extremism in West Africa and the Sahel, addressing security and political cooperation challenges in West Africa and the Sahel, supporting climate governance processes in Africa through research, policy advice and technical support, and supporting transitional justice processes across the continent, including in Ethiopia and the Lake Chad Basin.
